name: Look AI Ventures
decision_note: Prague-based pre-Series A AI fund (qualified-investor SICAV) that joined the Lucida AI, Sodex Innovations and Embodied AI rounds between June and September 2026.

funds.name: Look AI Ventures I (sub-fund of Look AI Ventures SICAV, a.s.)

evidence.quote: Look AI Ventures is a pre-Series A venture capital fund based in Prague, Czech Republic, investing in early-stage AI startups.
While we primarily focus on European AI startups, we also invest globally in companies with strong technical capabilities and scalable business models, regardless of sector.
The Fund is managed by FTP Dimension investiční společnost, a.s., Company ID No.: 296 59 302 (https://www.ftpis.cz/).
The targeted investment amount in one start-up is €250,000 and mentorship will be provided.
It aims to raise €20 million which will be invested in early stage AI-driven companies.
Investoři z pražského fondu Look AI Ventures přispívají do stále oblíbenějšího oboru fyzické AI.
Look AI Ventures has backed Embodied AI, a Lausanne-based robotics startup building robots that learn new tasks directly on factory production lines.
The round was led by Capmont Technology, with participation from Bloomhaus, Look AI Ventures, Superangels, SOSV, and 12 Rounds Capital.

Český fond Look AI Ventures se podílel na investici do startupu Lucida AI, který vyvíjí hlasovou AI platformu pro výuku mluvené komunikace v cizích jazycích a konkuruje tak globálním hráčům typu Duolingo.
INDUSTRY Media & Entertainment Country Czech Republic Founded 2025

analyst_notes: Discovered via Lupa.cz (2026-09-30, Embodied AI). Capital: fund size not disclosed; the EUR 20m figure (2023) is a fundraising target only, recorded under funds with event 'target'.
